info.name: Tooang - Cross Tenant Isolation (Menu, Meja, Place)
info.description:
HTTP tests proving tenant isolation for places, menus (categories + items), and dining tables.

Prerequisites:
1. Backend running (default baseUrl http://localhost:3001/api/v1).
2. Fixtures loaded: `CONFIRM_TEST_SEED=1 SEED_TEST_PASSWORD=<pwd> npm run prisma:seed:cross-tenant` (backend/).
3. Environment variable `fixturePassword` equals SEED_TEST_PASSWORD.

Run the folders in order (Collection Runner or `newman run`). Folder 05 verifies that no cross-tenant write took effect.
Re-run the seed to restore the baseline before each full evidence run.

Expected denial contract: foreign-tenant place/child resources -> 404 NOT_FOUND (no existence disclosure); global-only listing -> 403 FORBIDDEN.
